title: Network Delay Time: Settle the Earliest Arrival
summary: Dijkstra settles servers in order of arrival time: a min-heap of candidates, a table of best times, and stale entries skipped.

takeaway.summary: Pop the closest unsettled node from a min-heap and settle it; relax its outgoing edges, pushing a neighbor only when the new distance is shorter. Skip popped entries for settled nodes.
whenToUse: Shortest paths or earliest arrival with non-negative edge weights
Weighted graphs where BFS's hop count isn't the cost

scenes.narration: Five servers, joined by one-way links that each take a few milliseconds. Server 1 sends a message at time 0, and every server forwards it the moment it arrives. When does the last one hear it?
scenes.caption: Server 1 broadcasts; each link takes its own time

scenes.narration: Listing every route to every server explodes, and plain BFS counts hops, not milliseconds. Dijkstra settles servers in order of arrival time instead.
scenes.caption: Every route is too many; BFS counts hops, not time

scenes.narration: A min-heap holds candidate times. Pop the earliest, server 1 at 0. Every link adds time, so no other route can reach it sooner: it's settled.
scenes.caption: Pop server 1 at time 0: settled for good

scenes.narration: Server 3 settles at 1. Its link to server 2 takes 2 more, so 3 milliseconds, sooner than the direct 4. The table updates and (3, 2) joins the heap.
scenes.caption: Via server 3, server 2 hears it at 3, sooner than 4

scenes.narration: Server 2 settles at 3. Later the old entry (4, 2) comes out, but server 2 is done, so this stale entry is skipped.
scenes.caption: (4, 2) is stale: server 2 already settled at 3

scenes.narration: Server 4 settles at 5. Going on to server 3 would take 6, not sooner than 1, so nothing changes.
scenes.caption: From server 4, server 3 would take 6: it already has 1

scenes.narration: Server 5 settles at 6. The heap is empty and every server has the message; the latest arrival is 6.
scenes.caption: Server 5 settles at 6, the last arrival

scenes.narration: That's Dijkstra's algorithm: settle the closest unsettled node, relax its outgoing edges, and skip stale heap entries. With non-negative weights it runs in O(E log E) time.
scenes.caption: Dijkstra: settle the closest, then relax its links
